I spent most of yesterday checking every receipt in my wallet and every purchase shown by the banking app. The grocery store, train ticket, and pharmacy payments all match, but one card payment from a shop I have never visited remains on the statement. Nobody in my household used the card, I still have the physical card with me, and I did not authorize anyone else to use its details. I want to report that specific card purchase because I do not recognize it.

Earlier this week I sent money from another bank account into this account using the account details shown in the app. The sending bank says the transfer completed successfully, the reference and destination details are correct, and more than the normal processing time has passed. I have refreshed the balance several times and checked the transaction history, but the incoming bank transfer is still missing and my available balance has not changed.

At an automated cash machine I selected a withdrawal of two hundred, entered my PIN, and received cash without an error message. When I counted the notes immediately afterward, the machine had dispensed only one hundred and sixty even though the account was debited for the full two hundred. The issue is not a fee or an exchange rate; the amount of physical cash delivered by the machine was lower than the amount requested and charged.

A merchant confirmed that it approved my refund and sent it back to the same card I originally used. I have the refund confirmation and reference number, and the merchant says there is nothing else it can do. Several business days have now passed, but the refunded amount is absent from both my card activity and available balance. The original purchase is visible, so I need help locating the refund that should have arrived afterward.

I ordered a physical card after opening the account and received a message saying it had been dispatched. The estimated delivery window ended several days ago. I checked the mailbox, asked other people at the address, confirmed that the delivery address in my profile is correct, and still cannot find the envelope. I am not asking how long a new order normally takes; I am trying to locate a card that was already sent but has not arrived.

The app is asking me to prove my identity before I can finish setting up the account. I have tried taking clear photographs in good lighting, made sure the identity document is current, and checked that my personal information matches it exactly. The verification attempt still fails each time. I understand why identity checks may be required, but my problem is that I cannot successfully complete the verification process with the documents I have.

I made a transfer to a family member and the app shows that the transfer left my account. The recipient has checked the correct account several times and says nothing has arrived. This was not a scheduled transfer, I do not want to cancel it, and there is no pending indicator on my side. I need to understand why a transfer shown as completed has still not reached the person who was supposed to receive it.

While traveling I withdrew cash in a currency different from my account currency. The machine displayed the withdrawal amount, and later the app showed how much was deducted from my balance. When I compare those figures with the exchange rate for that time, the conversion used for the cash withdrawal appears substantially worse than expected. I am not disputing the withdrawal itself or a separate machine fee; my concern is the exchange rate applied to the cash transaction.
